rapport_notes: Rep is professional and clear but somewhat mechanical; minimal warmth or personalization, reads from script.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'does that make sense' after pricing explanation but did not hold silence (immediately continued talking); rep did not pause after 'does that feel fair' equivalent or close.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: So in order for us to give you a perfect quote, this would only take within the next ten to fifteen minutes of your time.
evidence_quotes.agenda: Before I proceed, do you have any other concerns or important things that you wanted to answer during this call? [Customer: No.]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep asked agenda question but customer answered 'no concerns,' so no follow-up was needed or attempted. Rep immediately pivoted to logistics probing (location, bedroom count, etc.).
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We have no worry damage coverage included on the already weight that you're paying us, we will provide up to 2000 dollars per move.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: We have meet to move our future. So a few days before you move we will be sending out emails letting you know who will be your movers are.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it to the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.
evidence_quotes.communication: Covered in 'meet your mover' — emails a few days before move with mover identity.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: A typical 2000 square foot home would normally take four version two trucks that is between six and a half to eight and a half hours to completely move. So, in your case we're doing packing and moving... we will split your move to two days... estimated time is between seven and a half and eight and a half hours.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_commit: We charge an early weight of 109 dollars per hour per mover... The only thing that is outside or already weight would be the packing cost.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_window: We're timely based. So in case if you still have extra [hours, the estimate adjusts].
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_beats_it: For any move. We have a minimum of two and a half hours once you go over that it will always be prorated in 215 minute increments [inverse logic — cost varies with actual time].
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_fair_silence: [Missing] Rep delivered pricing, said 'does that make sense' and continued without pause into estimate anchor; no follow-up silence held.

top_strength: Rep delivered all four core differentiators (damage coverage, meet your mover, on-time guarantee, communication/pricing clarity) in a logical order within the pricing/ramp section, ensuring customer walked away with a complete value proposition.
coaching_note: Hold silence after open-ended questions — rep asked the agenda question but did not pause for fuller customer response, and did not pause after 'does that make sense' or equivalent summary questions, breaking the Northwood pattern of letting customers breathe and surface concerns.
